name: Nishina Kyouka
source:
Anchor of a news program for which the main character is the director. She is mainly in charge of entertainment news.

She is high-minded and selfish, but has an easy-going personality. She has a keen sense of insight and is curious about scandals.

She is sexually uninhibited and faithful to her desires.

[From [url=https://gyutto.com/i/item1768?select_uaflag=1]Gyutto[/url]]
